name: La Bitácora de los Grandes Hoteles del Mundo

editorial.factPolicy: Cautious — no fabricated claims, reputational framing for unverified history

urlSafetyRules: All video IDs pass through getVideoId() which returns null if the string 'undefined' is found
All video IDs are passed through encodeURIComponent() before being embedded in URLs
Feed paths are validated for 'undefined' before fetch is called; section hidden if invalid
Thumbnail uses item.thumbnail only if it starts with 'https://' and contains no 'undefined'; falls back to hqdefault.jpg via video_id
shortsIntegration.feedSource: Real feeds generated separately by local yt-dlp script in hotelesfamosos-shorts/. Feeds are copied into hotelesfamosos/data/shorts/ before deployment. The website itself does NOT scrape, call YouTube APIs, or generate feeds.
